notes.title: Update to v1.4.0 - New Weapons and Tools
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

We're thrilled to present the latest update for United Assault - Battle of the Bulge! Get ready to experience enhanced gameplay, exciting new weapons, and a fresh rank system. Here's what's in store:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625399/12f41151e5828367edf2a1cd866d499db485a7b4.jpg[/img]

New Weapons: Equip yourself with five powerful new weapons to dominate the battlefield:

[b]P38[/b]: A classic German pistol known for its precision and reliability.
[b]MP34[/b]: A submachine gun perfect for close-quarters combat.
[b]Volkssturmgewehr[/b]: A versatile rifle ideal for a variety of situations.
[b]G43[/b]: A semi-automatic rifle with pinpoint accuracy.
[b]FG42[/b]: A fearsome light machine gun that delivers devastating firepower.
[b]New Tool[/b]: Introducing the Flare Pistol, a handy device that lets you illuminate dark areas and create strategic advantages on the battlefield.

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]: We've optimized the game to ensure smoother gameplay, reduced lag, and an overall improved gaming experience.

notes.title: Update to v1.3.1 - Bonus Campaign and Unreal Engine 5 update
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

Update 1.3.1 adds a new, 6 mission long bonus campaign to the game including new achievements and the update to Unreal Engine 5.





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/fb8cf3b6aa2db4378996c060cce862b06a2e3120.png[/img]
[list]
[*] added 6 mission bonus campaign
[*] added new achievements
[*] added new weather conditions
[*] added ray tracing option
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/7666bc8e317950f2a7af0483b13e1f4a296fc88f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] fixed mission loading issue
[*] fixed weapon pickups
[*] fixed several minor issues
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/1e5028f1e91364a0961f3503b9cda075d0b281e2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] updated to Unreal Engine 5.1
[*] updated and slightly rebalanced AI
[*] updated vehicles to use Chaos Physics Engine instead of Physix
[/list]

[h2][b]Important Informations[/b][/h2]
We started an update progress to Unreal Engine 5 a while ago and abandoned it because of the sheer number of bugs and issues the upgrade brought with it. This time it took us roughly a month to get the game fully working on UE5 with a lot of bugs fixed early on. However there is a potential this update brought with it new until unnoticed bugs we did not catch. Please report all bugs so we are able to fix them!

The game was not designed around Ray Tracing, which means especially interiours can be to dark at certain weather conditions. We are aware of this and want to correct this with future updates!

[h2][b]Savegames and Progression[/b][/h2]
The update to Unreal Engine 5 forced us to rework savegame compatibility. This means with this update Settings and Progressions are reset. There is a way to recover your old progression but this might cause game crashes.

[b]Recovering Progress at your own risk:[/b]
[list]
[*] Open the folder [i]C:\Users\DUsername\AppData\Local\UnitedAssault\Saved\SaveGames[/i]
[*] Create a subfolder called [i]BotB[/i] if it does not already exist
[*] Copy the file [i]BotB_Progression.sav[/i] into the new [i]BotB[/i] Subfolder
[/list]

[h2][b]Playing the legccy Unreal Engine 4 game (v1.1.0)[/b][/h2]
The old Unreal Engine 4 version of the game is available [i]legacy[/i] branch.

[b]We’d love to keep you up-to-date! Please join us also on Discord or on Facebook[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/yz5UyKzeSy] Discord [/url]

notes.title: Update to v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

This update is a massive milestone for the future of United Assault! After several month of development we can finally unleash the performance boost! United Assault Normandy '44 and Battle of the Bulge are where mostly CPU limited games due tue the large number of AI on the map. The bottleneck in this case was the default navigation mesh used by Unreal Engine 4.

United Assault does not render every AI across the map but they are still present and are active across the entire map (at a lower update rate) to simulate the true dynamic nature of the game. This came with the downside of having up to 1000 AI actors navigating the same navigation mesh at any time.

[b]We have now replaced the default Unreal Engine Navigation System with a proprietary solution which increased cpu limited performance up to 45%![/b]

Dieses Update ist auf CPUs der unteren bis mittleren Preisklasse ausgerichtet und sollte den CPU-Engpass deutlich beseitigen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625399/d5dd4dff23862438bab60c715e507e7bd8999062.jpg[/img]

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of the Ardennes.

notes.title: Release Date and Feature overview
notes.content:
[h2]United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is releasing 07th April 2022 in Steam Early Access![/h2]

[i]Gameplay Teaser[/i]
[previewyoutube=w6X1CWOJDS0;full][/previewyoutube]

United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone addon to United Assault - Normandy '44 and is build up on it's foundation.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Detailed open word based on their real world location of the Ardennes
[*] Dynamic mission generator
[*] Countless authentic weapons
[*] Detailed progression system
[*] Nvidia DLSS 2.0 support
[/list]

[b]Changes compated to United Assault - Normandy '44[/b]
[list]
[*] Larger, more detailed cities
[*] Deploy as a real paratrooper
[*] 21 authentic WW2 Weapons (6 new british weapons)
[*] Drivable vehicles can be found across the gameworld
[*] Procedural generated underground bunkers complexes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41625399/9621a96c6ddf2b3528e1a62ec2b3ed55c6880929.jpg[/img]

Early Access means the game is not finished just yet but is ready for testing. This also means not all features are available on day one and content will follow in with weekly updates. At the start of the Early Access you can explore half of the gameworld and rank up until rank 16 out of 40 ranks. New weapons, parts of the gameworld and drivable vehicles will be added over the time of early access.

The procedural generated underground bunkers complexes are expected to be available in the final weeks before the full release. The estimated final release of United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is 2-4 month into the future from early access launch. This all again depends on your feedback!
